subject: Re: POC re-qualification and scope expansion — Alder Retail
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@alderretail.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@alderretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Alder POC — post-demo recap & proposed next steps

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — good conversation. Quick recap + proposal so we have clear success criteria and next steps for the POC: 

Scope (what we agreed):
- Ingest last 12 months of product Q&A + transaction metadata (anonymized) into a scoped index.
- Two trial flows: (1) Conversational product search (chat-like retrieval + rerank), (2) Short-answer extraction for product specs.

Success criteria (initial):
- Retrieval recall: >70% top-5 for the pilot query set (50 queries)
- Latency: median response < 350ms for conversational path under 50 qps
- Stability: no more than 1 error per 500 requests in test window
- Business metric: increase in accurate product match rate by +8 percentage pts (measured against labeled set)

Deliverables & owners:
- Redwood: ingestion pipeline + demo index, monitoring dashboard, evaluation checklist (owner: me) — delivery target: 2 weeks from SOW start.
- Alder: provide data export and a 50-query labeled evaluation set (owner: Elena) — please confirm by next Wed.

Attachments: Alder_POC_outline_v1.xlsx (detailed timeline & checkpoints) and Redwood_POC_quote-Nov2026.pdf (pricing for dedicated pilot).

Next steps:
1) You confirm data handoff date and whether the 50-query set is feasible.
2) If yes, we target SOW countersign the week of Nov 29 and begin ingestion first week of Dec.
3) Weekly checkpoint calls during the pilot; first check-in scheduled for Dec 10 (tentative).

If you want to add any other concrete acceptance metrics we should measure during the pilot, flag them now so we can bake them into the checklist.

Thanks — looking forward.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Sean — thanks for the clear recap. Quick clarifications / asks from our side after syncing with the category leads: 

1) Add one more use case: conversational "assisted product discovery" where the model suggests filters/attributes proactively (example flows attached). This is higher priority than short-answer extraction.
2) We need audit logging (who queried what, timestamps) retained for 90 days for compliance. Is that part of the pilot?
3) Timeline: if we push the SOW counter-sign to Nov 29 we will still need two additional weeks for our security review (legal + infosec). Can Redwood start ingestion with synthetic/anonymized sample data earlier so we don't lose time?

If Redwood can accept the added use case and confirm audit logging retention, we'll move forward — I'll prioritize getting the 50 labeled queries and the data export.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Product Analytics | Alder Retail
elena.ruiz@alderretail.com

Subject: Rebaseline ask — Alder Retail POC (adds + compliance)

Team — following Elena's note we need to rebaseline scope for Alder. Key asks: add "assisted product discovery" as a primary use case and confirm 90-day audit log retention for the pilot. Implications below and a proposed path forward.

Impacts:
- Feature: conversational proactive suggestions will require adding a lightweight intent detector + prompt templates; small change to runtime but increases eval coverage (additional 50 queries).
- Data: audit logging is enabled by default in Redwood Private; hosted pilot will require a 90-day retention configuration and SCIM/KMS notes for their infosec team.
- Timeline: adding the use case and audit retention bumps delivery by ~2 weeks for engineering + integration testing.
- Cost: marginal increase reflected in quote (about +8% for effort).

Proposed checklist & owners:
- Updated acceptance checklist (attached: updated-success-checklist.xlsx) — Marissa to review and suggest any metric thresholds we should tighten.
- Security evidence packet for Alder infosec — Karthik to prepare SOC 2 scoping notes + retention confirmation.
- Revised SOW & quote — I will request an updated quote from finance; need approval on +8% uplift.

Can you both confirm feasibility and whether the 2-week shift is acceptable? If yes I will update the POC outline and send a revised SOW link for countersignature.

Thanks — Sean

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@alderretail.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@alderretail.com>

Subject: Re: POC re-qualification and scope expansion — Alder Retail (updated timeline & next steps)

Elena / Tom — thanks for the quick turnaround and for prioritizing the labeled queries. This confirms the updated plan we discussed internally and the revised acceptance checkpoints. Summary below and immediate asks so we can start on Monday.

What changed (agreed):
- Primary flows: (A) Conversational product discovery (proactive suggestions + filter helpers) and (B) Retrieval-based product QA (secondary).
- Acceptance checkpoints (updated):
  • Retrieval recall: top-5 > 72% on combined 100-query set (we added 50 for the new use case)
  • Conversational suggestion precision: measured sample of 100 suggestions, target > 65% judged relevant by category leads
  • Latency: median < 380ms for conversational path at 50 simulated qps
  • Audit logs: 90-day retention, logs available via S3 link and include request metadata (timestamp, request_id, model_variant).
- Timeline: SOW countersign by Dec 3 (DocuSign link below). Ingestion starts Dec 6 using anonymized sample (if provided earlier) with two-week internal QA; pilot demonstration week: Dec 20–24.
- Cost: adjusted quote (+8% uplift) attached in the updated Redwood_POC_quote-Nov2026.pdf.

Immediate asks for Alder:
1) Upload anonymized sample export to the SharePoint link by EOD Dec 1.
2) Confirm the 100-query evaluation set (we'll accept the labeled 50 + 50 new queries) by Dec 2.
3) Approve the adjusted quote via DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/alr-sow-2026 (expires Dec 6).

I'll schedule the kickoff call for Dec 6 once the SOW is countersigned. If Alder's security team needs the SOC2 notes before countersign, Karthik is ready to share the packet.

Thanks, and happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through the updated checkpoints.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
